contact.evidence_quote: Assistant Professor Marcela Gonzalez-Agüero, who, as Director of International Affairs at the EEUC, has sought opportunities to enhance the leadership and advocacy competencies of our APN students with the involvement of international faculty. She has also contributed to finding opportunities for international internships for our students with the aim of empowering them in their new roles.
